notes:
BUILD 29
- Icons: every newer item (rockets onward) could show as blank on some graphics cards because the icon sheet was taller than 2048 pixels. It now fits.
- Explosive 5.56 has its own model (black band, red tip), goes off with a small blast where it lands, and does 20% of the rifle's damage to blast and vault doors (was 75%).
- The hotbar shows which round is loaded in each gun, in the corner of its slot.
- Eoka: no longer splits after one shot. It reloads with handmade shells (also buckshot or a pistol bullet), wears out over a dozen or so shots, and can be repaired.
- Crates dropped by helicopters and boats are gone after five minutes; the crate window shows the countdown.
- /boss (dev mode) brings the attack helicopter in.
- Jetpack removed.
